question.text: If PEG ratio < 1, the stock is MOSTLY interpreted as:

explanation.text: The Logic: PEG < 1 implies valuation is cheap relative to earnings growth. The Trap: Over/sell would mean PEG > 1. Cross-Exam Context: XV uses same convention. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Combine PEG with quality (ROE, debt) — cheap-and-good beats cheap-alone.
